Counted ceilings for scripts/check_python_static.py. A check passes when its finding count is <= the ceiling; it fails when the count GROWS. The silent-except ceilings are NOT a defect count: QA R4 audited every such block and deliberately kept these (cancellation-swallowing shutdown, expected chain fall-through, logging infra that would recurse). The ceiling freezes that adjudicated set so a NEW silent broad handler must be reviewed. Lower a ceiling whenever debt is paid down. Baseline taken 2026-10-07 (QA R5).

2026-10-29 QA R12 审计：023–026 批次为三服务接入共享基础设施（app/cache/policies.py、app/cache/protection.py、app/common/observability_base.py、app/common/perf_kpi.py、app/core/config.py、app/core/resilience.py），这些模块的容错/回退块与既有审计集同质（Redis 降级、埋点失败不阻断、平台探测 pragma、feature-flag 回退、池上限读取回退、连接关闭失败不阻断），已逐一核验均为'有意保留'语义（有注释说明），故同步上限并在此登记审计集，非静默变绿。admin-api 另含 core/idempotency.py:148 与 middleware/rate_limit.py:142 的 Redis close() 同质模式（与既有 core/rate_limiter.py 同块）。
